description: Cross-runtime golden fixture (WS-04-F06). Same physical 4-s signal, synthesized identically in both runtimes: az = 1.0 + 0.25*sin(2*pi*2.0*t) g, gx = 45.0*sin(2*pi*2.0*t) deg/s. Python consumes the 30 Hz resampled form (its Window contract), Swift the 100 Hz archive. gyro_rms_dps and cadence are rate-invariant; jerk_rms_gps converges across rates within the documented bandwidth tolerance (<=5% clean, WS-04-F02).
